sources.snippet: Nous team states that it saw refusals, deflections and CCP-framed answers on sensitive topics in the base model. It picked Qwen3.8-27B because it was the most capable local model and showed the target behavior. How was Arete-27B trained? The teacher was Inkling, an open model from Thinking Machines.

sources.title: Arete-27B — Model Drop — Dropday.ai
sources.snippet: Arete-27B is a supervised fine-tune of Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B using 52.8M tokens over two epochs at 64k context. It was trained with no RL or architectural changes to reinforce Western values across seven categories including freedom of expression, democracy, and privacy.
